newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Montenegro steelworks loses 107 mln dinars in '96.
newsitem.headline: Montenegro steelworks loses 107 mln dinars in '96.

text.p: Montenegro steel works Zeljezara Niksic ended 1996 with a 107.32 million dinars ($18.9 million) loss, the company's board of directors was quoted by Tanjug news agency as saying Friday.
The steel works had worked with only 41 percent of installed capacity for steel and 56 percent capacity for finished goods, the board of directors said after examining the company's annual report.
Shortage of raw materials and lack of working capital were cited as the key reasons for low capacity utilisation.
Low demand and slow recovery of the Yugoslav metal-processing and machine-building industries as well as excessive steel imports were reasons for the company's poor results.

Zeljezara Niksic produced 120,543 tonnes of raw steel in 1996, or 2.7 percent more than planned. It also produced 136,880 tonnes of finished goods -- 5.9 percent above the plan. This was 33.6 percent more than in 1995, the report said. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
